hints: Calculate reflex $\angle AOB = 2\pi - 2(1.1760) \approx 3.9312\text{ radians}$ and major arc $AB = 5(3.9312) \approx 19.66\text{ cm}$.
walkthrough:
In the right-angled triangle $\triangle OAP$ (with tangent perpendicular to radius, $\angle OAP = 90^\circ$):
$$AP = \sqrt{OP^2 - OA^2} = \sqrt{13^2 - 5^2} = \sqrt{169 - 25} = \sqrt{144} = 12\text{ cm}$$
$$BP = AP = 12\text{ cm}$$

Calculate the half-angle $\angle POA$ at the centre of the circle:
$$\cos(\angle POA) = \frac{OA}{OP} = \frac{5}{13} \implies \angle POA = \cos^{-1}\left(\frac{5}{13}\right) \approx 1.17601\text{ radians}$$

Determine the reflex angle $\angle AOB$ subtending the major circular arc:
$$\text{Reflex } \angle AOB = 2\pi - 2\angle POA = 2\pi - 2(1.17601) = 2\pi - 2.35202 \approx 3.93117\text{ radians}$$

Calculate the length of the major arc $AB$:
$$\text{Major Arc } AB = r \times \text{reflex } \angle AOB = 5 \times 3.93117 \approx 19.65585\text{ cm}$$

Sum the major arc and both straight tangent sections to find the total cord length:
$$\text{Total Length} = \text{Major Arc } AB + AP + BP = 19.65585 + 12 + 12 = 43.65585 \approx 43.7\text{ cm} \quad (\text{to 3 s.f.})$$
